The documented core package includes native JSON, directory and ZIP adapters. Other editorial formats use additional adapter packages with varying maintenance. Installing OTIO core does not establish AAF/FCP/Resolve interchange.

USD composes references, layers, variants and payloads with strength ordering. It supports non-destructive scene overrides; topology changes can still invalidate downstream work. MGR must retain its own asset identity and application-specific rigging boundaries.

Photoshop batchPlay may resolve its promise while returning an error result for an action. Document and layer IDs are more stable than array indices within a session. Adapter success must inspect individual results and the resulting document.

Use explicit motion budgets, reduced-motion behavior and measured browser journeys; favor transform/opacity where suitable and inspect actual rendering cost. Validate keyboard use, content access and complete flows separately from animation aesthetics.

fields.definition: Evaluation data and promotion. Required knowledge: Rights-cleared fixtures, blinded review, holdouts and regression thresholds
fields.productionUse: Use rights-cleared fixtures, independently separated hold-outs and blinded versioned review. Promote only against declared per-dimension gates with replayable evidence and rollback baseline.
fields.standards: Fixed brief, model/version, sample count, budget, blinded review and artifact provenance.
fields.papers: Selected VBench source behavior, CameraCtrl trajectory metrics and primary production accounts guide protocol design; published scores are not local trials.
fields.implementations: Use rights-cleared fixtures, independently separated hold-outs and blinded versioned review. Promote only against declared per-dimension gates with replayable evidence and rollback baseline. Selected source/API read scopes are listed in sourceIds; this does not claim inspection of every candidate implementation.
fields.models: DINO subject-consistency source inspected; no checkpoint or video score executed. Craft/physical dimensions need separate evaluators.
fields.datasets: Own/admitted positive and hard-negative fixtures: Train/test leakage, reviewer sees provider name, threshold chosen after results, regression hidden and previous baseline unavailable. Independent labels and rights are required for evaluation assets.
fields.licensing: VBench root Apache2 license read. Metric checkpoint/data licenses and fixture rights require separate admission; film references are study context, not reusable test footage.
fields.providers: A provider or DCC must prove this exact capability and preserve the required editable artifacts; product marketing is insufficient.
fields.nativeAlternative: A composite average can hide fatal failures. Minimum samples are a protocol choice, not a statistical proof of universal superiority.
fields.runtime: Catalog/planning tools run in Node without GPU. Provider execution, browser/DCC tests and metric runtimes remain separate.
fields.cost: Dataset/review maintenance and repeated trial expense; sample-size/power decisions declared before testing.
fields.failureModes: Train/test leakage, reviewer sees provider name, threshold chosen after results, regression hidden and previous baseline unavailable.
fields.evaluation: Execute the original acceptance criteria with the declared fixtures; save measured artifacts and runtime/evaluator version. Remaining evidence: Executed repeatable held-out comparison and promotion/rollback on actual production outputs.
fields.placement: Plugin first: the individual branch packet guides routing, native build and validation. Creation OS retains canonical requirements/assets/approvals; embedded files are knowledge until its application invokes the integration.
fields.acceptance: Model/provider promotion requires repeatable evidence and rollback criteria
